Outcome.DescriptionText: Strips of gold-pressed latinum, stacked behind a cargo shield. The Syndicate does not trust banks and evidently does not trust guards either. A ledger in the crate names a safehouse. Research Smuggling Interdiction to follow this lead up.
The cache was bait. Orion raiders drop out of warp over the site while the away team is still loading crates. Research Smuggling Interdiction to follow this lead up.

Under the latinum is a crate of prototype hardware nobody has declared at any border. Starfleet Command wants a word about its origin. The Syndicate wants it back. Research Smuggling Interdiction to follow this lead up.
